latest.title: AWS Lambda Explained: How Serverless Computing Works, Where to Use It, and How to Build Your First Function
latest.description: Learn how AWS Lambda works, why developers and organizations use serverless computing, and how to build your first Lambda function. This practical guide covers event-driven architecture, real-world use cases, integration with other AWS services, a Node.js example, deployment steps, security best practices, and cost optimization.

latest.title: From Linux Basics to AWS Resource Monitoring: My DevOps Learning Journey
latest.description: Explore my DevOps learning journey, from mastering basic Linux commands and Bash scripting to automating AWS resource monitoring with the AWS CLI. Learn how I used shell scripting to collect information about Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, and AWS IAM, while exploring cron scheduling and remote server management with MobaXterm.

latest.title: How to Get $100 in Free AWS Credits (Plus $100 More): A Step-by-Step Guide
latest.description: New to AWS? You can start with $100 in free credits and earn another $100 by completing five simple activities. Here’s exactly how to claim them, what to avoid, and how to make every dollar last.

Is serverless still meant for humans to understand? Plus Claude Code agent teams and mods that aren't sandboxed.

trending.title: The Journey to AWS Community Day Accra: A Note of Gratitude
trending.description: When building cloud software for everyday humans, our ultimate goal is to see real communities thrive through technology. That vision took me on an unforgettable journey this past month: traveling to Accra, Ghana, to speak and demo our project at AWS Community Day Accra.

trending.title: 无侵入监控和回放 Claude Code 会话执行过程
trending.description: Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer 可以直接读取本机已有的 Claude Code 记录，将对话、工具调用和子 Agent 的执行过程关联起来，在浏览器中查看。接入时不需要在 Claude Code 中安装插件或修改配置，使用 Sessionizer 之前留下的历史记录也可以回放。

trending.title: Crear agentes de IA en minutos con AgentCore harness
trending.description: Veamos cómo Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness te permite crear, desplegar y escalar agentes de IA listos para producción en minutos, al convertir la complejidad de la infraestructura y la orquestación en configuración sencilla.

trending.title: Amazon ECS Gateway Explained: A New Approach to ECS Ingress and Platform Engineering
trending.description: Amazon ECS Gateway simplifies ingress management by enabling platform teams to standardize networking while giving application teams a self-service way to expose their ECS services. Explore what ECS Gateway provisions behind the scenes, how service routing works, key architectural considerations, and what to validate before rolling it out. Less manual configuration, fewer operational bottlenecks, and a better developer experience.
